scope: Reused GSE226572 development endpoint; full QC-admitted PBMC population, not B-cell prediction
split: Exclude entire query donor and query time across all training donors in each of 18 folds
model: linear interpolation in hours of equal-donor mean response at each training time; zero-response anchor at 0; constant boundary extension after final training time
baseline: equal-donor, equal-within-donor-time mean response from identical training subset; plus no change
gate: at least 5 percent lower equal-within-donor-time mean RMSE against both baselines in each of three held-out donors
